basic_profile.bio: I'm a 39-year-old music enthusiast and tech hobbyist based in Portland, Oregon. I work as a freelance audio engineer and spend my free time exploring different subcultures online, especially music genres like Deathcore and classic bands like Velvet Underground. I've been vaping for about a decade, and I'm always on the lookout for the next best thing in e-cigarettes. I'm single, and I usually browse Reddit in the evenings after work, often while listening to new music or tinkering with sound equipment.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I hold a degree in audio engineering and have been working in the music industry for over 15 years. My knowledge in electronic devices largely comes from self-teaching and hands-on experience, especially in amplifiers and audio equipment. I also have a fair amount of knowledge in harm reduction, particularly concerning vaping and quitting substances like weed.
